All seed data cleaned (bookings by guest_email iter610*, folio_items/upsell_log/upsell_claim_tokens for those bookings, iter610rev booking, email_outbox iter610*, arrival_reminder_log iter610*). Note: iter609 seeded default £25 enabled event package retained; not touched.
critical_code_review_comments: upsell_engine.py claim_upsell: expiry compared as ISO string — works only because both are UTC ISO format and same length; safer to parse datetimes. Also, invalid-token branch defaults lang to 'en' before checking token existence — good UX default.

arrival_reminder.py _with_claim_links: PUBLIC_BASE_URL from env used for claim URLs; if unset, links will be relative ('/api/revenue/upsell/claim/…') — acceptable but consider falling back to Origin header or request base_url so emails always contain absolute URLs.

bookings.py run_review_requests_internal: uses booking.review_request_sent_at existence for idempotency; when a guest already left a review, the field is set to 'skipped_already_reviewed' (a string, not ISO) — logic-safe but linters/consumers filtering by ISO parsing could break. Consider a separate flag review_request_skipped_reason.

booking_widget.py ota_conversion: attach_rate_pct uses widget_bookings (source='website_widget'); pk_bks query uses 'source' not restricted to widget — so packages taken via non-widget channels inflate the numerator relative to denominator. Verify semantics match product intent (attach rate ≈ widget-only vs widget-only?).

booking_widget.py ota_conversion: pk_bks projected only {'package':1,'nights':1} but 'id'/'total' etc. not fetched — that's fine here. by_package aggregates on name_tr fallback to name_en, but if both missing labels bucket into 'Paket' — cosmetic.
automation_settings.py: review_request registered under category 'guest' with default_cron 11:00 — matches spec.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (package-sales-card + all 3 sub testids visible on OTA Commission → Özet under Franziskaner branch)
